notes: Two taḥwīl branches: the first (Yahya and Ibn Ramh, a dual «قالا») ends at al-Layth; the second (Qutayba, from Layth) is written in full; «عن أبي الزبير، عن جابر» after the last «ح» is the shared tail.
«وابن، رمح» is Ibn Ramh with the conjunction attached; the conjunction is not part of the name.
